children: URSB Bancorp's net interest income and noninterest income rose year over year, while net income increased primarily due to higher net interest income and noninterest income and lower provision adjustments, partly offset by higher noninterest and income tax expenses.
Revenue (net interest + noninterest income) was $3M, compared with $2.27M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 32.3%.
Net income was $273K, compared with $124K in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 120.2%.
: Increased 29.3%, primarily due to a 19.0% increase in average interest-earning assets; net interest margin rose to 2.85% from 2.63%.
: Average loans increased $64.8M, or 23.5%, to $341.3M, with the average loan yield rising to 5.82% from 5.72%.
: Rose 106.7% to $186,000, reflecting higher fees, BOLI cash value, annuity investment value and a gain on loan participations.
: Noninterest expense increased 33.5%, primarily reflecting higher salaries and benefits and professional fees.
